assumptions.claim: In Status.NftWon, address(this) still holds prizeTokenId on prizeToken at redemption time and prizeToken.transferFrom(address(this), winner, prizeTokenId) transfers ownership to winner without reverting or pausing.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L128-L131) and Raffle.onERC721Received (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L421-L430) establish initial escrow; nothing found on-chain prevents an external prizeToken contract from later pausing, blacklisting winner, or moving the token outside standard ERC-721 rules prior to L334 (post-transfer ownership is checked at L335-L337).

assumptions.claim: In Status.NftWon, prizeToken.ownerOf(deliveredPrizeTokenId) == winner truthfully reflects durable ownership of prizeTokenId by winner after prizeToken.transferFrom returns.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (checked via external call to untrusted prizeToken at packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L335-L337; truthfulness of prizeToken.ownerOf relies on external contract behavior).

assumptions.claim: In Status.CashWon, quoteToken holds at least cashAmount for address(this) and executes transfer(winner, cashAmount) without fee-on-transfer, rebasing, or blacklisting reverts.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.buyEntries (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L223-L224, L233) and Raffle._settleWinningTicket (L539-L555) establish accounted liability bounds; nothing found on-chain enforces fee-free, non-rebasing, or non-blacklisting behavior of quoteToken beyond the decimals() == 6 and contract-code checks in RaffleFactory.constructor (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L66-L78).

assumptions.claim: When settlementComplete is already true on entry, winningTicketId was previously validated to contain winningEntry and terminal liabilities (including winnerProceeds for Status.CashWon) were allocated.
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle._settleWinningTicket (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L538-L555), the sole writer of settlementComplete = true (L551).

assumptions.claim: ERC721._balances[winner] >= 1 prior to the unchecked decrement in ERC721._update during _burn(ticketId).
assumptions.establishedBy: ERC721._update (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L217, L230, L236), which increments _balances[to] by 1 whenever _owners[tokenId] is set to a non-zero address.

callers: External entrypoint (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L309), restricted to msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId) (L320-L321); no internal callers.

calls.propagates: Reverts with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall if REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE == ENTERED (2), sets slot to ENTERED (2) before body execution, and resets slot to NOT_ENTERED (1) after execution (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L118).

On the !settlementComplete path (L314-L315), verifies status is NftWon or CashWon (L535-L536), verifies ticketId's stored range contains winningEntry via _requireWinningTicket (L538, L579-L585), partitions unsettledPot into protocolFees, sponsorProceeds, and (for CashWon) winnerProceeds (L539-L555), zeroes unsettledPot (L553), sets winningTicketId = ticketId (L552), and sets settlementComplete = true (L551).

Called by _settleWinningTicket (L538); reads _ticketRanges[ticketId] (L451-L455) and reverts with TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry if winningEntry < firstEntry || winningEntry > lastEntry (L579-L585), rejecting unminted tickets (0, 0) since winningEntry >= 1 (L518-L519).

Called by _settleWinningTicket (L540, L546); computes floor(grossPot * bps / 10_000) via 512-bit multiplication without overflow since 500 < 10_000 and 8000 < 10_000 (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol:L206-L277).

Reads _owners[ticketId] and reverts with ERC721NonexistentToken(ticketId) if _owners[ticketId] == address(0), returning a non-zero owner address (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC721/ERC721.sol:L61-L63, L146-L148, L426-L432).

Bypasses _isProtocolDestination because to == address(0) (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L498), clears _tokenApprovals[ticketId] (ERC721.sol:L227, L398), decrements _balances[winner] unchecked (ERC721.sol:L230), sets _owners[ticketId] = address(0) (ERC721.sol:L240), emits Transfer(winner, address(0), ticketId) (ERC721.sol:L242), and verifies previousOwner != address(0) (ERC721.sol:L305-L307).

Untrusted external call on the Status.NftWon branch (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L334) with (address(this), winner, deliveredPrizeTokenId); assumed to transfer ERC-721 ownership of prizeTokenId from address(this) to winner, and any revert rolls back the entire redemption transaction.

Untrusted external staticcall on the Status.NftWon branch (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L335) with (deliveredPrizeTokenId); caller requires return value == winner or reverts with PrizeDeliveryVerificationFailed(winner) (L335-L337).

On the Status.CashWon branch (L342, L564-L567, L593-L605), screens winner against address(this), factory, quoteToken, i_vrfV2PlusWrapper, prizeToken, factory.raffleImplementation(), and (when winner.code.length != 0) factory.isRaffle(winner), reverting with InvalidQuoteDestination(winner) if matched, then calls quoteToken.safeTransfer(winner, cashAmount).

Called by _isProtocolDestination (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L601, L603); returns the immutable implementation address and registry status from the trusted factory (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L42, L54).

Called by _transferQuote (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L566); invokes quoteToken.transfer(winner, cashAmount) via assembly call and reverts if the call fails, returns false, or returns empty data when extcodesize(quoteToken) == 0 (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol:L33-L37, L176-L200).

invariants.claim: redeemWinningTicket can succeed at most once per Raffle clone, and only when status is Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon.
Redemption only succeeds for the unique ticketId whose stored range contains winningEntry, and leaves settlementComplete == true and winningTicketId == ticketId.

Only the exact current ERC-721 owner of ticketId (not an approved operator) can execute redeemWinningTicket, and ticketId is burned (_owners[ticketId] == address(0)) along with winnerRedeemed = true and winnerRecipient = winner before any external prize or quote-token call occurs.
On the Status.NftWon branch, prizeClaimed is set to true before prizeToken.transferFrom is invoked, cashAmount is 0, and completion requires prizeToken.ownerOf(prizeTokenId) == winner.

On the Status.CashWon branch, cashAmount > 0, winnerProceeds is zeroed before _transferQuote is invoked, and winner is re-verified not to be a protocol destination before quoteToken.safeTransfer executes.
